title: Canonical Definition Consistency Rules
description: Rules for Canonical Definition uniqueness, non-duplication, and non-contradiction. Specification only.

rules.statement: A Knowledge Record MUST contain exactly one Canonical Definition (single definition string/section).
Canonical Definition MUST include Scope and SHOULD include Out of scope.
Canonical Definition MUST NOT embed engine scoring logic or application if/else substitutes for rule database content.
After freeze, Canonical Definition changes REQUIRE an approved change request and re-review.
Duplicate Canonical Definitions across two active (non-deprecated) KR-* for the same concept are forbidden.
Internal contradictions between Canonical Definition and high-confidence assertions in the same record are forbidden.
Definitions that presuppose another concept SHOULD declare Hard or Semantic Dependency accordingly.
Uncertain classical attributions inside the definition MUST be marked TODO_REVIEW — never invented.
